ceu: ✦ The opposition between Mercury and Mars

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your inner life and routine. A short pause avoids a long argument.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Step away from a group that only brings you down.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between friendships and romance. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your career and family. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your horizons and conversations. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Forgive someone in your heart, even without telling them.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between intimacy and money. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Suggest a plan for the two of you this week.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between relationships and your image. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Help a colleague with something small: it comes back to you twice over.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between routine and your inner life. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Surprise someone you love, even if it is just a note.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between romance and friendships. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Make a family recipe and share it.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between family and your career. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Turn off notifications for an hour and notice the calm that follows.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between conversations and your horizons. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Keep a coin in a special place as a symbol of your prosperity.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between money and intimacy. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Take five minutes when you wake up to decide how you want to feel today.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your image and relationships. Hear both sides before you decide.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Say no to a commitment that wears you out.
